phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Read a plan. Make your first deliberate change.

phases.title: Private platforms
phases.description: Deliver applications through explicit security boundaries.

phases.title: Hybrid operations
phases.description: Connect networks. Diagnose the whole path.

labs.title: Azure, infrastructure as code, and Terraform
labs.outcome: Explain Azure hierarchy, desired state, providers, and the Terraform resource graph.

labs.title: Prepare your workstation and subscription
labs.outcome: Verify your tools, tenant, subscription, permissions, quota, and regional availability.

labs.title: Your first Azure deployment
labs.outcome: Create, change, inspect, and destroy a resource group through a reviewed plan.

labs.title: Variables, types, and validation
labs.outcome: Reject invalid inputs and explain variable precedence before changing resources.

labs.title: References, locals, data sources, and outputs
labs.outcome: Use references and data sources to compose names, tags, dependencies, and outputs.

labs.title: Collections and resource identity
labs.outcome: Choose stable resource addresses using collection types, count, and for_each.

labs.title: IP addressing, CIDR, VNets, and subnets
labs.outcome: Design non-overlapping network ranges and allocate explicit subnets.

labs.title: NSGs and application security groups
labs.outcome: Prove allow and deny decisions using priorities, NSGs, and application security groups.

labs.title: Explicit outbound connectivity
labs.outcome: Provide a deliberate outbound path with NAT Gateway and private workload subnets.

labs.title: Private Windows VM and IIS
labs.outcome: Bootstrap a private Windows/IIS server and verify it through the Azure control plane.

labs.title: Private administration with Bastion
labs.outcome: Administer Windows over Bastion without a public VM address or public RDP rule.

labs.title: VNet peering and its limits
labs.outcome: Demonstrate direct peering connectivity and the limit of non-transitive peering.

labs.title: Routes, next hops, and Network Watcher
labs.outcome: Predict longest-prefix route selection and inspect the effective next hop.

labs.title: State, addressing, and locking
labs.outcome: Explain state addresses, ownership, locking, and the limits of local state.

labs.title: Drift, import, and refactoring
labs.outcome: Detect drift, import ownership, and preserve resource addresses while refactoring.

labs.title: Azure remote-state bootstrap
labs.outcome: Bootstrap a protected Azure backend, migrate state, and rehearse reverse cleanup.

labs.title: Your first reusable module
labs.outcome: Refactor a concrete network into a reusable module with useful outputs.

labs.title: Module contracts and safe changes
labs.outcome: Define module contracts and predict replacement, lifecycle, and validation behavior.

labs.title: Environment and state separation
labs.outcome: Separate environment configuration, state keys, and operational ownership.

labs.title: Compose a network from structured inputs
labs.outcome: Compose multiple networks from typed maps without hiding their relationships.

labs.title: Test Terraform behavior
labs.outcome: Test input validation and planned behavior with mocked providers and assertions.

labs.title: Azure DNS and private DNS
labs.outcome: Resolve a private name and understand zone links and authoritative DNS boundaries.

labs.title: Storage private endpoints
labs.outcome: Resolve Blob Storage to a private endpoint and disable its public service path.

labs.title: Managed identity and Key Vault
labs.outcome: Use managed identity and scoped RBAC to access private sample data.

labs.title: Azure Firewall and Firewall Policy
labs.outcome: Build a Firewall Policy and distinguish network rules from application rules.

labs.title: Inspected hub-and-spoke routing
labs.outcome: Inspect selected spoke and outbound traffic without creating asymmetric routing.

labs.title: Application Gateway WAF and private IIS
labs.outcome: Serve HTTPS through WAF to healthy private IIS backends and prove a blocked request.

labs.title: Monitoring and diagnostic evidence
labs.outcome: Collect diagnostics and guest telemetry, query evidence, and validate an alert.

labs.title: VPN and hybrid routing foundations
labs.outcome: Explain IPsec, gateway transit, propagation, route selection, and BGP purpose.

labs.title: Simulated on-premises connectivity
labs.outcome: Prove an encrypted connection to an Azure-hosted simulated on-premises network.

labs.title: Hybrid DNS with Private Resolver
labs.outcome: Resolve Azure private services and corporate lab names across the VPN.

labs.title: RBAC, policy, budgets, and locks
labs.outcome: Apply practical permissions, policy, budget notifications, and resource locks.

labs.title: Provider aliases and subscription boundaries
labs.outcome: Map provider aliases explicitly and understand cross-subscription prerequisites.

labs.title: Network incident investigation
labs.outcome: Diagnose a broken service by following DNS, routes, enforcement, and application health.

labs.title: Git collaboration and pull-request checks
labs.outcome: Review infrastructure changes through credential-free pull-request quality checks.

labs.title: GitHub Actions authentication with OIDC
labs.outcome: Configure a federated managed identity for GitHub Actions and backend access.

labs.title: Reviewed plan, apply, and destroy workflows
labs.outcome: Review a saved plan and use an explicitly invoked protected deployment workflow.

labs.title: Recovery and controlled upgrades
labs.outcome: Recover ownership and state, resume interrupted work, and review provider upgrades.

labs.title: Capstone architecture workshop
labs.outcome: Complete the address plan, traffic matrix, permissions, cost review, and readiness gate.

labs.title: Build Terraforming Azure
labs.outcome: Integrate and prove the complete staged regional hub-and-spoke architecture.
